lesson.observeGeneric: Si taxadar leh u baadh nidaamka, oo u fiirso haddii ay jiraan wax is-beddelaya oo midab, xumbaaro, ama heer-kulka ah.
lesson.observeReacting: Falcelinta ayaa socda — u fiirso isbedelada akhriska pH iyo heer-kulka.
lesson.partGas: xumbaaro si joogto ah uga baxaysa
lesson.partPrecipitate: dareeraha ayaa daahnaanta galay oo rasaab soo baxay
lesson.partColor: midabka dareeraha ayaa si cad u bedeladay
lesson.partExo: xagga kale kulaylka ayaa la sii daayay oo heer-kulku kacay
lesson.partEndo: xagga kale kulaylka ayaa la nuugay oo heer-kulku hoos u dhacay
lesson.summary: Tijaabadan iyada oo la adeegsanayo, waad {objectives}.
lesson.narrSetupElectrode: Geli daraawiishta dareeraha korontada-kala-saarka, oo xid mid walba tallaabada positive iyo negative ee ilo-korontada tooska ah.
lesson.narrPowerOn: Fur ilo-korontada tooska ah si aad u bilowdo elektrolisis-ka — u fiirso isbedelada laba-daraawiishta.
lesson.narrSetupCircuit: Xidid laba daraawiishta adigoo galanometer-ka u isticmaalaya xadhig, ka dibna geli dareeraha elektrolite-ka.
lesson.narrConnectOn: Xidid wareegga, oo eeg haddii tilmaamaha galanometer-ku uu qaloociyo.
lesson.narrSetupConduct: Xidid xalal isku-dhegan oo xoogana leh mid walba wareeg korontada oo leh laambad.
lesson.narrConductTest: Xidid wareegga, oo barbardhig iftiinka laambadaha ku jira xalalka kala duwan.
lesson.narrSetupGeneric: Raac sawir-wareegga si aad u xidid daraawiishta iyo ilo-korontada / aaladaha cabbirka, ka dibna geli elektrolite-ka.
lesson.narrRigOn: {verb}，fiiri si taxadar leh isbeddelka labada qudhac iyo qalabka cabbirka.
lesson.narrHeat: Shid laambada kohol si aad {vessel} u kulayso — falcelintani waxay u baahataa xaalad kuleyl.
lesson.narrMixHeated: Kadib kuleylka, walaaq reagents-ka si buuxda; falcelinta ayaa isla markiiba bilaabata.
lesson.narrMix: Walaaq reagents-ka ku jira {vessel} si buuxda; falcelinta ayaa isla markiiba bilaabata.
lesson.electrodesFading: ；midabka buluuga ah ee xalka ayaa si tartiib ah u baaba'aya
lesson.outlineHint: Marka aad gasho miiska tijaabada, guji “Sharraxaadda Tijaabada ▶” si aad u aragtid muujinta talaabo-tallaabo.
lesson.noVoice: Luqaddani codla ma laha, sharaxaadda waxay si toos ah u socon doontaa qoraalka hoose.
lesson.narrHeat_beaker: Shid laambadda kohol si aad koobka shaybaarka u kululeyso — falcelinta waxay u baahan tahay kulaylka si ay u dhacdo.
lesson.narrHeat_tube: Shid laambadda kohol si aad tuubada tijaabada u kululeyso — falcelinta waxay u baahan tahay kulaylka si ay u dhacdo.
lesson.narrHeat_flask: Shid laambadda kohol si aad flaskiga u kululeyso — falcelinta waxay u baahan tahay kulaylka si ay u dhacdo.
lesson.narrMix_beaker: Si fiican u walaaq maadooyinka ku jira koobka shaybaarka; falcelinta ayaa markiiba bilaabata.
lesson.narrMix_tube: Si fiican u walaaq maadooyinka ku jira tuubada tijaabada; falcelinta ayaa markiiba bilaabata.
lesson.narrMix_flask: Si fiican u walaaq maadooyinka ku jira flaskiga; falcelinta ayaa markiiba bilaabata.

home.labDesc: Geli daawooyin kujbaha, matoorka falcelinta wuxuu isla markiiba go'aamiyaa midabka, xumbaynta, ururinta iyo isbeddelka heerkulka — waxa aad aragto ayaad helaysaa.
home.tutorTitle: Macallin AI ah oo Shaybaarka ah
home.tutorDesc: Xilligan kasta su'aalo ka weydii mabaadiiga iyo hawlgalka. Markaad falcelin muhiim ah ku kiciso xariiqa, macallinka ayaa si firfircoon sharaxaad iyo ogeysiis ammaan ku siin doona.
home.reportDesc: Waxay urursaa dhammaan xogta tijaabada oo dhan, si toos ah u abuurta gabagabada, falanqaynta cilladaha, talooyin horumar ah iyo qiimeynta xogta muhiimka ah.
home.badge: Shaybaar Kiimikaa Xun oo AI u Waddo
home.heroDesc: Jiid daawooyin, u dajiso midabka iyo xumbaynta, xilligan kasta macallinka AI weydii, oo tijaabada dhamaadkeedii warbixin dhisan si toos ah u soo saarto. {count} tijaabo xaqiijisan, amaan oo dib loo celin karo.

stir.label: Walaaq
stir.effect: Ku walaaq ul dhalo ah; tuurka ayaa si dhakhso ah u milmaya oo khaladaadka si siman u kala baxa
stir.hint: Walaaqista waxay dedejisaa milmida iyo wareejinta kulaylka, sidoo kale waxay siman kartaa xoogga maxalliga ah si akhriska uu matalo dhamaan xalka

shake.label: Gaari
shake.effect: Gaari si aad u walaaqdo; reagents-ku waxay si buuxda isugu xidaan
shake.hint: Dareeraha tuubada yar ayaa lagu xoqaa (ma xoqin) si loo isku daro; hays afka tuubada meel aan qof ku jirin

heat.label: Kululee
heat.effect: Shid laambadda kaluunka si aad u kululeysid; heerkulka nidaamku wuu kororaa
heat.hint: Kululayntu waxay dheereysaa xawaaraha falcelinta badankeeda; falcelinta nuugta kulaylka waa in si joogto ah loo kululeeyo

cool.label: Qabooji
cool.effect: Ka saar isha kulaylka; nidaamku si dabiici ah ayuu u qaboojaa
cool.hint: Qaboojintu waxay hoos u dhigtaa xallinimada; tani waa tallaabada caadiga ah ee kiriistaalka ka bixi iyo ururinta badeecada

settle.label: Degsiimo
settle.effect: Deg muddo yar; waxyaabooyinka hoos u dhacaya way degan yahay, lakabyaduna si cad ayay u kala qaybsamaan
settle.hint: Hoos u dhaca iyo kala qaybsanaanta waxay u baahan yihiin waqti; ka dib degsiimodda keliya ayaa la xukumi karaa in dareeraha sare ee saafi u yahay

read.label: Akhri
read.hint: Indhaha la soo waajah calaamadaha; geli akhrinta kasta jadwalka xogta si loo xisaabiyo celceliska iyo khaladaadka

quant.verdictGood: Isku-xigxiga xogtu waa wanaagsan tahay, waxa loo isticmaali karaa xisaabinta
quant.verdictFair: Kala duwanaanshaha waa weyn yahay; hubi indhaha akhrinta iyo xaaladda nidaamka
quant.verdictPoor: Kala duwanaanshaha aad ayuu u weyn yahay; baadhi sababta ka dibna ku celi qiyaasaha la mid ah
quant.finalGroup: Gabagabadu waxay ku salaysan tahay kooxdan
quant.singleReading: 1 qiyaas oo kaliya, kala duwanaanshaha xiriirka lama xisaabin karo (xeerka wuxuu u baahan yahay ugu yaraan 2 qiyaas oo la mid ah)
quant.worstDeviation: Ugu badan kala duwanaanshaha celceliska xiriirka {value}%
quant.groupNote: Mar kasta oo nidaamka laga qaato / lagu daro / loo kululeeyo, koox cusub ayaa la furaa; akhrinnada kooxaha kala duwan kuma aha qiyaasaha la mid ah, sidaas awgeed gaar ayay u xisaabsan yihiin.
quant.noReadings: Tijaabadan kuma jirto wax qiyaas ah oo lagu duubay hawlgalka “Akhri”, sidaas awgeed celceliska iyo kala duwanaanshaha xiriirka lama xisaabin karo. Tijaabada tirada ah waxay u baahan tahay in ugu yaraan 2 jeer la akhriyo xaaladda nidaamka oo isku mid ah.

report.notGenerated: Warbixinta weli lama soo saarin. AI waxay ku saleynaysaa tillaabooyinka hawlgalka iyo akhriska cabbirka ee tijaabadan si ay u bixiso gabagabada, falanqaynta khaladaadka, talooyinka horumarinta, iyo qiimeynta fahanka.
report.noActivity: Tijaabadan ma laha wax diiwaangashan oo hawlgal ah; warbixinta weli lama samayn karo.
